IFS.Title: Injury & The Fading Spirits
IFS.Status.Injury.Name: Injury
IFS.Status.Injury.Description:
When a character first falls from positive hit points to 0 hit points, an injury episode begins. Recovering to positive hit points during that episode adds one injury stack.

Injury stacks range from 0 to 3; at 0–2 stacks, the current stack count becomes the character's death save failures. At 3 stacks, the GM must rule on direct death, an environmental exception, or a deferment before death is written.

Full healing, a successful short rest, or a successful long rest clears injury.

A retained natural 19 or 20 on a death save counts as a critical success.
